chunks.content:
16.4 MATLAB EXAMPLES
A leapfrog finite difference time domain (FDTD) numerical approximation to
the 1D Dirac equation is demonstrated in this section. The routine below is for
demonstration purposes in applying a leapfrog method to a system of first order
equations. Numerical solution of the Dirac equation for various applications is an
active area of research. The reader is encouraged to consult additional references
for numerical codes in pursuing research problems. Comparison of the results
of numerical simulation with analytical solutions and periodically checking
normalization is recommended.
Key MATLAB commands: meshc, subplot
Programming: for loops, function statements
